name: Trig Functions & Graphs
roadmap: Master the trigonometric functions by understanding the ASTC quadrant rule, analyzing wave transformations, and developing efficient strategies for solving quadratic trigonometric equations across the full 0° to 360° range.
roadmap_zh: 透過理解 ASTC 象限法則、分析波形變換，以及建立在 0° 至 360° 全範圍內求解二次三角方程的高效策略，全面掌握三角函數。

concepts.name: The ASTC (CAST) Rule
concepts.key_takeaway: The ASTC rule tells us which trig ratios are positive in each quadrant: All (I), Sine (II), Tangent (III), and Cosine (IV). Use this to find all possible angles between 0° and 360°.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: ASTC 法則告訴我們每個象限中哪些三角比為正值：全部 (I)、正弦 (II)、正切 (III) 和餘弦 (IV)。利用此法則可尋找 0° 至 360° 之間的所有可能角度。

concepts.name: Wave Anatomy & Transformations
concepts.key_takeaway: For any sine/cosine wave, Amplitude = $|a|$, Period = $360^\circ/b$, and the vertical shift $c$ determines the principal axis about which the wave oscillates.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 對於任何正弦/餘弦波，振幅 = $|a|$，週期 = $360^\circ/b$，而垂直平移 $c$ 則決定了波形振盪的主軸。

concepts.name: Solving Trigonometric Equations
concepts.key_takeaway: Solve quadratic trig equations by factoring (like $u^2 - u = 0$) and then using the ASTC rule to find ALL valid solutions within the given range (usually $0^\circ \le \theta < 360^\circ$).
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 透過因式分解（如 $u^2 - u = 0$）求解二次三角方程，然後利用 ASTC 法則在給定範圍內（通常為 $0^\circ \le \theta < 360^\circ$）尋找所有有效解。

common_traps.description: Failing to check all relevant quadrants. For example, if $\\sin\theta = 0.5$, students often find 30° but forget 150°.
common_traps.description_zh: 未能檢查所有相關象限。例如，若 $\\sin\theta = 0.5$，學生常只找到 30° 而忘記 150°。
common_traps.fix: Always sketch the ASTC quadrants and mark the two quadrants where the trig ratio has the required sign.
common_traps.fix_zh: 務必草繪 ASTC 象限，並標記出該三角比符號符合要求的兩個象限。

common_traps.description: Mistakenly taking the coefficient $b$ as the period instead of using $360^\circ / b$.
common_traps.description_zh: 錯誤地將係數 $b$ 視為週期，而非使用 $360^\circ / b$。
common_traps.fix: Remember the formula: Period = $360^\circ / b$. Higher $b$ values 'squeeze' the graph tighter, making the period shorter.
common_traps.fix_zh: 記住公式：週期 = $360^\circ / b$。較高的 $b$ 值會使圖像「擠壓」得更緊，從而使週期變短。
